title: ACL ticket: correct list, wrong direction
summary: Repair an ACL attachment without changing the approved rule set.
brief: MGMT-SAFE already permits SSH from 192.0.2.0/24 and denies other IPv4 traffic, but the policy was attached in the wrong direction on Ethernet1. Inspect the rule list and running configuration, then correct only the interface direction. This local configuration ticket cannot generate traffic or ACL counters, so it grades the exact binding plus the evidence commands rather than claimed reachability.
hints: The rules may be correct even when policy behavior is wrong.
Use the running configuration to determine the applied direction.
Reuse MGMT-SAFE; do not recreate its entries.

checks.label: MGMT-SAFE is applied inbound only on Ethernet1
